items: AI helps QSRs keep service fast and consistent across every store as they grow into multi-location brands or franchises.
At the drive-thru, AI can take orders and confirm items with guests, which reduces the wrong or missing orders that lead to refunds and bad reviews.
AI that replies to reviews and analyzes their sentiment at scale shows you which locations have a service or quality issue before it spreads.
In the kitchen and back of house, AI can sequence tickets, track prep times to catch bottlenecks and match ordering to forecasted demand to cut food waste.
